title: 第一卷 第6章 饭真香！
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那倒没有，是线人告诉我的，应该不会错，而且那女人已经住到他家了。”

沙发上的女人猛然站起来：“住进去了？”

面前的男人重重点头：“绝对不会错！”

女人哈哈大笑起来：“好好，就让他找个乡下的女人，我要让他一辈子不能翻身，要不是他，我儿子也不会……”

女人的眼眶瞬间红了：“没要他的命已经算我善良了，报告一上来立刻批了，不要被我大哥看见，老爷子更不能知道。”

“这……万一被发现了？”

“我儿子连娶妻生子的机会都没有。”女人捂着脸呜呜哭了起来，男人伸手揽住她的肩膀，柔声安慰：“别哭，明言说想你了，一会就来了，要让他看见，他又要伤心了。”

女人缓了一会擦了擦眼角：“幸亏还有明言陪着我，你去让刘姐多做点菜，明言喜欢的菜都做上。”

“好好好，都听你的，我就知道你最疼明言了。”

“人都是相互的，虽然他是个你侄儿，但是那段时间是他陪着我，我对他好是应该的。”

男人眼中闪过一丝笑意。

季望棉将行礼放进主卧。

客卧只有一个窗户，采光不行，她只是看了眼窗户念叨一句光线好暗，萧临戍立刻把主卧让给她。

季望棉看了窗明几净的房间，满意了。

转头跟萧临戍道谢：“萧大哥~~谢谢你。”

萧临戍掐着手心，让自己不要太掉价：“应该的，你是女孩子，东西多，住大房间合适。”

季望棉：……

单薄的包裹！你确定不是在阴阳我！

萧临戍也发现了，赶紧道：“好多东西路远是不容易带，我这边有很多票，一会我给你，你缺什么就去买！那个什么，你先收拾，其他的一会再说。”

季望棉知道这是萧临戍给她的体面。

她的小包里只有三身衣服，和原主舍不得的书。

季大伯留给她的小包

季望棉有些意外，这怕是他们季家一半的存款了，这全国粮票更难得，本地粮票跟它的兑换是一比二点五。

足见可贵。

季大伯有心了！

不过这些衣服太破旧了，布丁摞布丁，虽然是同色布丁，针脚也很密，但她是不会穿的。

得做衣服了！

既然要留下来，季望棉在心里盘算着这个院子怎么改造。

首先必须，一定要有一个她自己的厕所。

刚才她去了一趟公共厕所，刚进门就被满地的地雷惊住了。

她实在无法理解，脚踏黄河两岸的坑不踩，满地埋地雷是什么爱好。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"That's not true. The informant told me. It shouldn't be wrong. Moreover, the woman has already lived in his house."

The woman on the sofa suddenly stood up: "Have you moved in?"

The man in front of him nodded heavily: "You can't be wrong!"

The woman laughed loudly: "Okay, let him find a woman from the country. I will make him unable to stand up for the rest of his life. If it weren't for him, my son wouldn't be able to..."

The woman's eyes turned red instantly: "I'm a good person for not taking his life. I will approve the report immediately as soon as it comes up. Don't let my elder brother see it, and the old man can't know."

"What if...what if we are discovered?"

"My son doesn't even have a chance to marry and have children." The woman covered her face and started to cry. The man put his arms around her shoulders and comforted her softly: "Don't cry. I made it clear that I miss you, and you will come soon. If you want him to see it, he will be sad again."

The woman calmed down for a while and wiped the corners of her eyes: "Fortunately, Mingyan is with me. Go and ask Sister Liu to cook more dishes. Mingyan will cook all the dishes she likes."

"Okay, okay, I'll listen to you. I know you love Mingyan the most."

"Everyone loves each other. Although he is your nephew, he was with me during that time, so I should be nice to him."

A smile flashed in the man's eyes.

Ji Wangmian placed the salute into the master bedroom.

There was only one window in the guest bedroom and there was no light. She just glanced at the window and said that the light was very dark. Xiao Linshu immediately gave the master bedroom to her.

Ji Wangmian looked at the bright and clean room and was satisfied.

He turned around and thanked Xiao Linshu: "Brother Xiao~~Thank you."

Xiao Linshu pinched his palms to keep himself from losing too much: "That's right. You are a girl. You have a lot of stuff, so it's suitable for you to live in a big room."

Ji Wangmian:......

Thin package!Are you sure you are not yin and yang me?

Xiao Linshu also noticed it and said quickly: "There are a lot of things that are difficult to carry on a long journey. I have a lot of tickets here. I will give them to you later. Buy whatever you need! You pack that and that first, and we will talk about the other things later."

Ji Wangmian knew that this was the dignity given to her by Xiao Linshu.

In her small bag, there were only three sets of clothes and books that the original owner couldn't bear to part with.

The small bag that Uncle Ji left for her

Ji Wangmian was a little surprised. This was probably half of their Ji family's savings. National food stamps were even more rare. The exchange rate for local food stamps was 1:2.5.

It shows how valuable it is.

Uncle Ji is interested!

But these clothes are too shabby, pudding upon pudding. Although they are puddings of the same color and the stitching is very dense, she will not wear them.

Gotta make clothes!

Since he wanted to stay, Ji Wangmian was thinking about how to transform the yard.

First of all, she must have a toilet of her own.

She went to the public toilet just now and was shocked by the landmines all over the place as soon as she entered the door.

She really couldn't understand what kind of hobby it was to not step on the pits on both sides of the Yellow River and to plant landmines all over the ground.
